questions.stem: The interior angles of any quadrilateral add up to:
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral can be split into two triangles, each with angles summing to $180°$. Therefore the interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $2 \times 180° = 360°$.

questions.stem: Three angles of a quadrilateral are $90°$, $85°$, and $110°$. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: Interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360°$. The fourth angle is $360° - 90° - 85° - 110° = 75°$.
